verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a provider-agnostic design. It connects to Ollama, OpenAI-compatible and Open Responses providers, and any OpenAI-API endpoint (OpenRouter, vLLM, Groq, etc.) can be added via a custom Base URL. Users can talk to any model and switch mid-conversation, or run models side-by-side. Missing for 10: explicit native Anthropic and Google provider support (only implied via OpenAI-compatible endpoints or Claude Code CLI backends), documented per-agent model assignment, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can plug in multiple model providers — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, and more — and switch models per agent or per conversation

citations.quote: anything that speaks the OpenAI API (Ollama, OpenRouter, vLLM, LM Studio, Groq, ...) is added as provider OpenAI with a custom Base URL.
